text:
morgan: Heads-up — planning a Dedicated rollout for AeroPulse this Thursday 22:00 PT (quiet window 22:00-01:00). Need sign-off to pin serving binary to `release-2.3.1` during the slice swap and to hold KV-cache priming for 30m after traffic shift.
sasha: Can you confirm KMS key rotation schedule? We have a rotation scheduled Thu 23:30 in their tenant, might collide. :eyes:
ravi: I just checked AeroPulse support ticket — KMS rotation is optional for this week; they said engineering can delay it if needed. I'll ping customer.
morgan: Perfect. Also: patched model -> quantized q4f16; perf numbers looked good in staging (p95 infer down ~12%). Release notes here: https://redwood-internal.docs/releases/aeropulse-2.3.1
kevin: Two asks from infra: 1) reserve Dedicated slice for 3h starting 21:30 PT, 2) enable burst capacity to 1.5x during cutover for 20m. OK?
julie: From SRE: rollback policy — if tail latency > 350ms or error rate delta > 0.8% for 5m we abort and rollback. Also set canary at 5% for 10m then 25% for 15m.
morgan: Agreed on rollback thresholds. For KV-cache: we'll drain prefixes for 10m then hold priming; ops-bot, can you enqueue a cache-warm job 15m after canary passes?
ops-bot: @morgan cache-warm job scheduled: `cw-job aero-2.3.1` at +15m after canary green.
deploy-bot: Deploy checklist triggered by morgan:
- Reserved slice: bordereau-AP-aero-01 ✅
- Canary config: 5/10m -> 25/15m ✅
- Pin serving binary: `release-2.3.1` ⏳
- KV-cache hold: 30m ⏳
- KMS rotation check: conflict flagged by sasha ⚠️
sasha: After talking to infra, let's delay KMS rotation to Friday 02:00 PT. AeroPulse agreed. I updated the ticket.
ravi: Customer confirmed delay. They also asked for a short rollback note to be included in the post-deploy email.
morgan: I'll draft the email with bullet rollback steps and who to @call. Draft: "If we hit rollback thresholds, we revert to `release-2.3.0`, re-enable previous cache priming, and notify AeroPulse and Redwood oncall via #incidents." Anyone add edits?
kevin: Add step to invalidate new in-flight KV prefixes before reverting, otherwise stale state risk.
julie: Also include a quick smoke command they can run: `curl -sS https://aero.example/health | jq .latency` and where to look in the console: Console -> Dedicated -> bordereau-AP-aero-01 -> Metrics -> latency / errors.
morgan: OK. Last item: request approval from product for release-note blurb (customer-facing). @sasha can you ping product? :pray:
sasha: Pinged product in #product — Ana will review and revert by EOD tomorrow.
morgan: Great. If no objections, I'll mark the pin and request the reserved slice. Everyone reply with :thumbsup: to approve schedule and rollback plan.
sasha: :thumbsup:
ravi: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
julie: :thumbsup:
morgan: :shipit: Deploy prep in motion — I'll post a final go/no-go in this thread 60m before window. deploy-bot will run the preflight at T-30m.
deploy-bot: Preflight scheduled at 1768506121 (T-30m). Checks: slice readiness, quota, network routes, canary config. Will post results here.
ops-bot: Noted — cache-warm job will remain paused until canary green."
